exact: modulation by symbiont of defense-related host salicylic acid-mediated signal transduction pathway
modulation of defense-related host SA-mediated signal transduction pathway by organism
perturbation of defense-related host salicylic acid-mediated signal transduction pathway
broad: modulation by organism of defense-related salicylic acid-mediated signal transduction pathway in other organism involved in symbiotic interaction

definition: A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts a salicylic acid-mediated signal transduction pathway in its host. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host salicylic acid-mediated signal transduction pathway
